q: One is never afraid of the unknown; one is afraid of the known coming to an end.
The best mind-altering drug is the truth.
Try all things, hold fast that which is good.
It's easier to lose than to win.
Be as simple as you can be; you will be astonished to see how uncomplicated and happy your life can become.
Goals are the fuel in the furnace of achievement.
A very little key will open a very heavy door.
A liar knows that he is a liar, but one who speaks mere portions of truth in order to deceive is a craftsman of destruction.
The world makes way for the man who knows where he is going.
Excellence is not a skill. It is an attitude.
If you set your goals ridiculously high and its a failure, you will fail above everyone elses success.
I didn't get there by wishing for it or hoping for it, but by working for it.
Victims recite problems, leaders provide solutions.
Comedy = tragedy + time.
Better a diamond with a flaw than a pebble without one.
The constant assertion of belief is an indication of fear.
Be brave. Take risks. Nothing can substitute experience.
Life doesn't get easier or more forgiving, we get stronger and more resilient.
Singleness of purpose is one of the chief essentials for success in life, no matter what may be one's aim.
A wise person should have money in their head, but not in their heart.

Tis not too late to seek a newer world.
The only limit to our realization of tomorrow will be our doubts of today.
Don't let the noise of others' opinions drown out your own inner voice.

If we are not able to smile, then the world will not have peace.
True love stories never have endings.
Make peace within, and there will be no one who can overcome you. And no one you will wish to overcome.
It is not fair to ask of others what you are not willing to do yourself.
You have the potential for greatness.
Integrity is the ability to stand by an idea.
Before you can see the Light, you have to deal with the darkness.

Always look on the bright side of things. If you can't comprehend this, polish that which has become dull until it begins to shine.
We are shaped and fashioned by what we love.
Don't risk what is important to you, to get what is not important to you.
Kindness is a language which the deaf can hear and the blind can see.
Receive without complaint, Work with fate.
